profile_scope: Dedicated Photato release benchmark process sampled for five seconds; 2814 of 3514 main-thread samples were within the changed-parameter render. 1372 samples were in its output pixel-write call subtree. This is sampling evidence, not an allocation count.
implemented: Direct default-subscript mutation of Swift COW tile arrays removes optional read/modify/write allocation overhead
Prepared premultiplied pattern samples capped at 4 MiB per sampler; larger patterns keep the sparse Surface fallback
Unit mask coverage is proven over pixel-center regions; only the renderer opts in. Continuous edges and group mixing keep their existing paths
Pattern Fill Auto-Select samples a single stored content pixel without allocating a full canvas
limits: Performance reports have two samples, not p95, and include reference-buffer memory; no live Photoshop comparison
Large-image parameter previews are still slower than interactive frame rates
4 MiB pattern preparation is per sampler; large tiles use the existing slower sparse lookup
Full CPU compositions, group memory budgets, vector/feather preparation, SDR packing and GPU acceleration remain open
Exactness here means equality to existing native/source behavior in the stated checks, not broad Photoshop output identity
macOS14/26 and Intel runtime qualification remain pending
